title: Flai, which makes AI tools for car dealerships to manage phone calls, emails, and texts, raised a $27M Series A led by Base10 Partners (Sean O'Kane/TechCrunch)
summary: Sean O'Kane / TechCrunch: Flai, which makes AI tools for car dealerships to manage phone calls, emails, and texts, raised a $27M Series A led by Base10 Partners — When Flai was raising its seed round last year, it was just a team of three people pounding the pavement to get car dealerships to use the startup's software …
